hello: Ah, you're back. I've hidden the good biscuits, just in case you cry.
Good day. Shall we see how quickly you can bugger up a perfectly nice afternoon?
Welcome, darling. Your pieces are ready, even if your brain bloody isn't.
Hello again. I've brought my reading glasses and an enormous amount of patience.
praise: Oh, well played. Did someone whisper it to you, or was that a happy accident?
A rather good move. I'm almost proud, which is a damned unsettling feeling.
Goodness, competence. How bloody refreshing, and how terribly unlike you.
Bravo. Even a stopped clock is right twice a day, as they say.
inaccuracy: A trifle sloppy, darling. Like a soggy sandwich.
Oh, not your finest, is it, old thing.
Slightly off. Rather like milk left out in the sun.
mistake: Oh, how dreadful. That's a proper shambles of a move.
Bloody hell, darling. That was a genuine mistake.
My word. That move belongs in the bin, frankly.
That was rubbish, I'm sorry to say. Utter rubbish.
blunder: Oh, splendid. You've just set fire to the whole bloody game.
Dear heavens, that's a blunder so daft it deserves its own plaque.
Well, shit. I'm going to need a very large gin after that one.
A colossal blunder. Even the board looks thoroughly ashamed of you.
win: A win, darling. I'd pop the champagne, but let's not encourage you.
Victory, of a sort. Rather like winning a pie-eating contest by accident.
You've won. Your opponent must be weeping into their bloody cornflakes.
Well done. A dreadful game, a lucky result, and a damned fine fluke.
lose: Defeated, darling. Thoroughly, comprehensively, and rather amusingly.
You lost. Let's call it character building, shall we, you poor sod.
And that's that. You were outplayed by every measure known to mankind.
A loss. Your opponent ate you for breakfast and asked for seconds.
draw: A draw. Two people politely failing at the same damned time.
A draw. Like a cricket match rained off before anyone bothered to play.
A draw. Rather like a dinner party where nobody brought the wine.
Even, then. Neither of you could finish the bloody job.
review.ok: A so-so game. Some sensible bits, some utterly baffling bits.
Decent enough, I suppose. Like a sandwich from a petrol station.
Middle of the road, darling. Neither triumph nor bloody tragedy.
Fairly ordinary. A few nice moves, and a fair amount of nonsense.
review.bad: A poor show, darling. Let's dig through the wreckage, shall we.
That went badly. Rather like a picnic in a thunderstorm.
A bad game. You fumbled about like someone looking for their keys in the dark.
Not pretty, old bean. Not pretty in the slightest, damn it.
review.terrible: Good grief. That game was an unmitigated bloody disaster.
I've seen tidier wreckage after a hurricane, darling. Dreadful.
That was a horror show from start to finish. Pass the gin.
Heavens above, that was shite of the very highest order.
book: Theory, darling. Lovely. A tape recorder could do the same.
Well memorised. Now let's see if there's a brain behind the bloody memory.
Book move. Splendid photocopying, I must say.
Ah, the textbook move. Every schoolchild knows it, so don't get smug.
Known theory. Even my aunt's cat has played that one, damn it.
A borrowed move. Copied from far cleverer people than you, darling.
idle: A sleepy move from them. Do wake up and exploit it, you dozy thing.
Your opponent is twiddling their thumbs. Do something clever for once.
They've done bugger all. Your turn to do slightly more than that.
Rather a dull move from them. Don't match it with an even duller one.
They're fiddling about. Have a proper look, darling, there may be something.
A quiet little move. Suspicious, isn't it? Or are you too busy dozing?
opening: A classic opening. Do treat it better than you treat your houseplants.
Oh, a well-known opening. I'm sure you'll find a new way to ruin it.
A fine opening, darling. Let's see how long before it all goes to hell.
A venerable opening. The old masters would weep, frankly.
A good opening. Shame you only know the first bloody page of it.
Ah, a proper opening. Now, do try to remember what comes next.
check: Check, darling. I'd deal with that rather swiftly if I were you.
Check. Do stop admiring the scenery and get out of it.
Oh look, check. How bloody predictable. Sort it out.
Check, you poor lamb. Find an exit, sharpish.
You're in check, old bean. Panic quietly and solve it.
Check. Kindly extract yourself from this damned mess.
retry: A second chance. More than most people get, so don't squander it.
Back we go. Pretend that never happened, as I shall try to.
Take it back, darling. And this time, do think first.
Another try. Third time lucky, perhaps, if this one goes to hell too.
Ah, the undo button. Your truest friend in this bloody game.
Very well, again. Slower this time, and with actual thought, for once.
hint: Need a little nudge, darling? The arrow will hold your hand.
A hint, how humbling. Follow the arrow and try to look clever.
Here you are. Do pretend you'd have found it yourself.
There's your clue. Even you should manage this one, surely.
Ah, the arrow of shame. Off you go, then.
A hint already? Good heavens, we've barely begun, you useless thing.

book: Book move! Excellent reproduction of somebody else's work, copycat!

blunder: Blunder, recruit! You just surrendered the whole damn fort!

win: Victory, recruit! Don't get cocky, it was sloppy as hell!
